name: Staircase
summary: Every section is one clear step up: one new layer, one new register, never a step back, until the top step.
motif: The same motif on every step, each time one layer richer; at the top it jumps an octave.
surprise: The top step lands on a borrowed chord (say bVI) instead of the expected tonic.
ending: An abrupt, coordinated cutoff on the top step.
